song.title: Martyr Song
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G Em They overcame by the blood of the Lamb .G Em And by the words of their testimonies .G Em They loved not their lives even unto death .G Em They loved not their lives even unto death
[C1] . G Raise up an army of laid down lovers . Em Raise up an army of laid down lovers . G Em If we die with Him, we will live with Him . G Em If we move with Him, we will rule with Him . G Em If we lay down with the Lamb, we'll roar with the Lion of Judah . G Em We'll roar with the Lion of Judah
song.author: Rick Pino
